name: PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16
significance: Inaugurated CD-ROM optical gaming on home consoles via the CD-ROM² add-on, leading the 16-bit generational transition in Japan.

verifiedFactualData.ram: 8 KB work RAM, 64 KB video RAM

editorialContent.overview: The diminutive Japanese powerhouse that outsold the Famicom in Japan and pioneered console CD-ROM optical media in 1988.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Inaugurated CD-ROM optical gaming on home consoles via the CD-ROM² add-on, leading the 16-bit generational transition in Japan.
